leadText:
Grand Spectrala Islet (Japanese: マホラ小島 Mahora Islet) is a Pokémon sanctuary and the fourth island , , and visited during their travels through the Decolore Islands. It is only accessible from Grand Spectrala Island when the tide is low, since the only bridge connecting the islands is destroyed.

Being mostly covered with a forest, the only building on the island is an abandoned Pokémon Center which shut ten years prior due to a decline in visiting Pokémon Trainers. Giant Pokémon are said to inhabit here, however, in The Island of Illusions! all of them were proven to be s created by a in order to protect the other wild Pokémon on the island from s.

The formerly abandoned Pokémon Center was recommissioned by its previous Nurse Joy, who was originally sent there to investigate rumors of an illegally operated Pokémon Center. With the help of Ash and , both Nurse Joy and Zoroark were able to clean up and reopen the center to heal the island's wild Pokémon.
